# HaloPOS

> HaloPOS is an all-in-one point of sale for Australian hospitality — storefront, cashier, kitchen display, mobile waiter, and GST-aware reporting in one system that runs online or fully offline. Melbourne-hosted and hardware-agnostic, with an optional AI Agent (early access) that takes orders across phone, chat, and in-store voice.

HaloPOS is built for Australian cafés, casual dining, bars, and high-turn counters. This file indexes the public marketing site. The product itself runs in a separate app at https://my.halopos.store, which is outside the scope of this file.

Key facts:

- All-in-one: online ordering/storefront, cashier/counter, kitchen display (KDS), mobile waiter, and reporting share one order and one source of truth.
- Runs online or fully offline — an on-site mini-PC can host HaloPOS with automatic sync on reconnect.
- Melbourne-hosted; GST-aware hospitality reporting with BAS export.
- EFTPOS via CommBank Smart (primary AU path), Tyro, and Smartpay; online card payments via Linkly; printers from Epson, Star Micronics, and Bixolon. Hardware-agnostic where it matters.
- Three pricing options: pay-as-you-go (1.4% per order, no monthly fee), subscription ($99/mo, or $89/mo billed annually, plus 1% per order), or a one-time on-site license. Website ordering and the AI Agent are paid add-ons.
- AI Agent is an optional early-access add-on that takes orders across phone, chat, and in-store voice; data is Australian-hosted by default.

## Product

- [HaloPOS overview](https://www.halopos.store/): All-in-one POS — storefront, counter, kitchen, and reporting; online or fully offline.
- [AI Agent](https://www.halopos.store/features/ai-agent): Optional early-access AI agent that takes orders across phone, chat, and in-store voice, straight into the POS and kitchen.
- [Hardware & setup](https://www.halopos.store/hardware): Compatible POS clients, printers, and EFTPOS, plus Counter Starter, Full Service, and Fully Offline packages.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://www.halopos.store/#pricing): Pay-as-you-go (1.4%/order), subscription ($99/mo + 1%/order, or $89/mo billed annually), or a one-time on-site license.
